section.12: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

12.name_native: The Book of The At-Tatbiq (Clasping One's Hands Together)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that 'Ali said:"The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade me from wearing gold rings, and Al-Qassi, and clothes dyed with safflower, and reciting Qur'an while I am bowing
